main_text.l: ARGVMENTVM, Genes.39.16. Acto.1.3. Hebr.11.1. Argumenta carnis, Iob.4.7.
ARIDA: Arida vocatur terra, Gen.1, 10. Psalm. 95.5. Matth. 23.15. Aridus, arida, succo & vigore exhaustus. Esai. 35.7. & 44.3. & 56.3.
ARIDVS, gratia Dei vacuus, Luc. 23. 31. Arida ossa mortuorum instar, Ezech. 37.4.
[ARIEL, Leo Dei, altare Hierosol. Esai.29.1. 2.7. Ezech.43. 15.16.
ARIMATHEA, vrbs in monte Ephraim, quae fuit patria Samuelis, Prophetae (1.Sam.1.1.) & Ioseph, qui corpus Christi sepultura mandauit, Luc. 23 30. &c.
ARIOCH, rex Ellasaris. Gen.14.19. Arioch, praefectus satellitum, Dan.2.14. 15. 24.25.
ARIOLI & Aruspices, Dan.2.v.2.27. & 4.6.& 5.v. 7, 11. Act. 19,13. Vide DIVINI, INCANTATORES, Astrologia.
ARISTARCHVS Pauli comes, Actor. 19, 29. & 20.4. & 27, 2. Col.4, 10. Philem.v.24. [Aristobulus, Rom 16 10.]
ARMA, Arma piorum quae, & qualia, 2. Corinth.10,4. Ephe. 6,13 1. Ioan.3.9. Vide PII. ARMA Pastorum, Vide PASTOR, [Arma bellica, & Venatoria, Deut.1 41. Gen.27.3.]
ARMAGEDDON, Apoc,16,16. Hebraea vox, quae idem est ac mons seu montana Megiddonis. Vide 2. Reg.23, 30, 2. Par. 35,22, Zach.12,11.]
ARMAMENTARIVM: Armamentaria clypeorum & hastarum per singulas ciuitates Iuda,2. Paral.11.12.
ARMATVRAE militis Christiani perelegans descriptio Ephes.6.14.&c.
ARMENTVM magnum pecus, minori (quale est ouis, agnus, oppositum, Gen.13 5.& 18,7. & 26,14. & saepius apud Moses & Prophetas.

ARMIGER Abimeleci, Iudic. 9,54. Ionathanis, 1. Sam. 14,1. &c. Ioabi,2. Sam,23,37, 1. Chr.11.39. Goliath. 1. Sam. 17, 7. 41. Sanlis,1.Sam.31,v.4. 5,6. 1.Par.10. 4 5.& 11.39. Armigeri decem Ioabi, 2.Sam.18,15.
ARMILLA, externum manus hominis ornamentum preciosum, Gen.24,22,30, 47. & 38, 18, 25. Exod. 35,22. Nu.31,
